verdict.rationale: Atlas documents its own registered agent for Delaware compliance, and a registered agent is the role that accepts service of process. That is the only evidence: nothing describes a physical street office, how service is received, or documents being scanned into the Atlas account the same day. missing for 10: documentation of acceptance at a physical street address, same-day scanning/upload of served documents into the account, notification workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received

citations.quote: Satisfy Delaware compliance requirements with a registered agent.
